Hi Erin — Priyom here (SE). Short answers and concrete steps below.

1) IP allowlist
- For the hosted POC we'll need Northridge to allow outbound HTTPS to Redwood staging endpoints and optionally allow inbound callbacks if you plan to test webhook flows.
- Staging egress IPs (example): 34.210.132.45/32, 52.204.11.18/32, 3.120.88.200/32. If you can allow the /32s that will be sufficient for the short POC period. If you prefer a single CIDR let me know and I can get the buddy range.

2) Sandbox provisioning
- We can provision ephemeral sandbox users on our side. Please confirm the admin email to bind (e.g., erin.walters@northridgehealth.com) and whether you want API-key scoped to read-only vs full test access.
- Steps I will perform: create sandbox account, generate scoped API key, send key and rotate instructions.

3) Endpoints & tokens
- Staging endpoint: https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
- Token format: rwd_test_<id> — tokens are scoped by default to the sandbox project we create.

4) Load test guidance
- For the kickoff load window we'll do a controlled ramp: 5 -> 50 -> 200 concurrent requests over 10 minutes (peak ~200 RPS, estimated 12k tokens/min depending on prompt length).
- If your infra team needs a lower peak, we can cap at 75 RPS. I recommend running the load test at the end of the session for around 10 minutes.

5) Attachments & links
- I attached a short access instructions file (redwood_access_instructions.txt) with the exact steps I'll perform.
- I'll create the sandbox and post credentials in a one-time secure link ~1 hour before the session.

If Fri 27th 10:00 PT works for you I'll send a calendar invite that includes a Zoom link and the test plan.

— Priyom
